race.comment: BONFIRE SPARK (8) stalked the leader then went home far too well in a BM70 here at this distance five weeks ago. Goes best with the runs spaced. Has a tricky gate to contend with but should go forward and prove tough to beat again. MOONHAVEN (2) settled near the tail then went through the gears nicely although never a threat first-up in a Class 6 here at this trip last time. Nicely in after McMurray's claim. Goes well second-up so he should build on that last performance. EVERYBODY RISE (4) made it five wins in succession when he led from barrier rise over today's track and distance three weeks ago. Should lead again from the inside alley and it would be brave to say he cannot make it six straight. THE FIXER (6) chased hard but was no match for EVERYBODY RISE last start, his first run for 28 weeks. Lightly raced veteran who can bridge the gap with that run under his belt.
